name: AI Drush Tools
description: Drush commands for module upgrade checks, Drupal.org project inspection, and optional AI-assisted analysis.

suggests.drupal/ai: Enables automatic integration with any configured AI provider (Anthropic, OpenAI, LiteLLM, etc.)

project_description: AI Drush Tools adds Drush commands for two Drupal maintenance tasks — checking whether core and contrib modules are compatible with the next major Drupal version, and inspecting Drupal.org project metadata (releases, usage by branch, maintainers, issue-queue summaries, security-advisory coverage). The deterministic checks resolve core modules from a built-in registry and look up contrib modules via Packagist with a Drupal.org update-feed fallback; the actual ecosystem lookups run in a bundled Python checker (drupal_module_checker) invoked as a subprocess. AI commentary is optional and additive: with --enrich-with-ai the module routes a prompt through a pluggable backend layer that supports the drupal/ai module, a LiteLLM proxy, a Python LiteLLM subprocess, and host-native AI CLIs (Claude, Codex, OpenCode) reached directly or through a DDEV host bridge. ai:setup writes backend defaults into drush.yml and ai:setup:bridge installs the DDEV host-bridge helpers. The module defines no routes, permissions, entities, or configuration objects — it is entirely command-line tooling.
